pages.text: I have finally obtained mana in a tangible form. It behaves as a luminous fluid: it can occupy the world, fill a bucket, and be stored by volume.$(br2)Spells measure their costs against this liquid. A bucket is therefore not merely a container but a useful unit of magical capacity.

The source I envision is a $(thing)Mana Percolator$(), which should gather mana through water and cut gems. Its construction is not yet complete. Until then, any mana I obtain by other means can still teach me how this fluid behaves.
pages.title: Current Limitation
